# State Class View (variant): Ground-truth and validation steward (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Ground-truth and validation steward (`seed:R05-ground-truth-validation-steward`, P1); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — journey L2, senior L3
- Design and steward field reference data for Earth-observation and AI models — journey L2, senior L3
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3
- Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence — journey L2, senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2, senior L3
- Build task-specific evaluation sets and benchmark AI tools before adoption — journey L2, senior L3
- Adjudicate automated species detections using field-formed identification expertise — journey L2, senior L3
- Calibrate field observers and run field measurement quality assurance — journey L2, senior L3
